interpretation_guardrails: Seven basins discussed at a consultation are not proof that seven plans are approved, implemented or operational.
The programme target of eleven basins is not a measured coverage denominator; do not calculate 7/11 as implementation progress.
The official sources establish institutional activity and planning signals, not warning effectiveness or avoided losses.
Do not infer that a public mobile application reaches every exposed person or that app delivery equals comprehension or protective action.
NOEMA-007 is an evaluation/measurement layer only; it must not issue duplicate official warnings or override competent authorities.
Only privacy-reviewed, permissioned aggregates may be used in public research; no person, device, message or exact household-location records are included.
